summary: Mostly ready. A few gaps keep some agents from fully reading or transacting with your store — the fix list below closes them.

checks.name: UCP capability profile found and valid
checks.detail: Published at https://sample-store.myshopify.com/.well-known/ucp/2026-04-08; capability areas: cart, checkout, discovery, identity, order.

checks.name: JSON-LD structured data present
checks.detail: No application/ld+json blocks in homepage HTML.
checks.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data (schema.org) to your pages. Agents parse structured data first; pages without it are effectively invisible to them.

checks.name: schema.org Product markup
checks.detail: No Product-typed JSON-LD on the homepage or a sampled product page.
checks.fix: Add schema.org Product markup with name, image, offers (price, currency, availability), brand and identifiers to product pages. This is the single highest-leverage agent-readiness fix for most stores.

checks.name: Organization identity markup
checks.fix: Add an Organization node (name, url, logo, sameAs links). It is the cheapest identity signal an agent can verify.

checks.name: XML sitemap present and parseable
checks.detail: 701 URL(s) listed (via sitemap index); ~700 product pages.

checks.name: Access for GPTBot (OpenAI crawler)
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Access for GoogleOther (Google AI crawling)
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Access for ClaudeBot (Anthropic)
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Access for CCBot (Common Crawl)
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Access for PerplexityBot
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Access for ChatGPT-User (on-demand agent fetch)
checks.detail: HTTP 200, same page as a normal visit.

checks.name: Overall agent accessibility
checks.detail: All 6 tested agent user agents can read the homepage.

checks.name: robots.txt posture toward AI crawlers
checks.detail: No AI-crawler tokens are disallowed in robots.txt.

checks.name: Key content in static HTML
checks.detail: ~20340 characters of visible text in raw HTML; content is server-rendered.

checks.name: HTML fundamentals
checks.fix: Add the missing fundamentals (H1 heading). They cost minutes and every parser — search or agent — relies on them.

checks.name: Product links in static HTML
checks.detail: 22 product-like links found in static HTML — agents can crawl your catalog.
